atomic-metadata: NIST level and line tables provide identities. The pinned Codex canonical_gf rows provide adopted log(gf), NIST accuracy grade and retained GES/VALD candidate columns. These historical candidates are not independent new external queries. An accuracy grade describes atomic-data uncertainty, not approval for a stellar analysis. NIST is an evaluated compilation; experimental/theoretical origins are not classified where the snapshot does not establish them. Missing H log(gf) and missing grades stay unknown, not zero. This explorer does not promote Theoretical Atomic Lab candidates.
